summary: Remove unreachable helper and flag code, and add adaptive request pacing with typed 429 errors.
reason: Dogfood identified unused error-classification helpers and global flags, while the AnyList protobuf client had no request pacing or structured rate-limit response. The removed helpers had no production callers; pagination helpers remain because an existing regression test exercises them, although the current dogfood analyzer reports those same-file helper calls as dead.
validated_outcome: Dogfood now reports zero dead flags and no source-client rate-limit warning. The only remaining dead-function warning is the analyzer's known same-file false positive for pagination helpers. Focused tests pass, including typed HTTP 429 coverage.
